_note: SYNTHETIC fixture for the W7 citation over-reach check, written by the ResearchOS developers before running the check (not independent). Sources are invented abstracts; keys are fictional. Expected verdicts: ok / over_reach / no_support.

sources.smith2020: We studied 120 adults with type 2 diabetes. Daily walking was associated with lower fasting glucose after 12 weeks. These results suggest that walking may improve glycaemic control.
sources.lee2019: In a randomised trial of 300 patients, the beta-blocker reduced the frequency of premature ventricular contractions by 40%. Adverse events were rare.
sources.wang2021: 本研究纳入了200名老年人。结果表明，睡眠时间较短与认知功能下降相关。
sources.chen2018: 我们在小鼠模型中证实，该药物能够降低血压。该效应在雄性和雌性小鼠中均可观察到。
sources.3: A convolutional network detected atrial fibrillation from single-lead ECG with a sensitivity of 0.94. Performance was lower in patients with pacemakers.
sources.4: Gut microbiome composition differed between patients with Parkinson's disease and controls.

items.sentence: Daily walking may improve glycaemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes {{cite:smith2020}}.
Daily walking lowers fasting glucose in adults with type 2 diabetes {{cite:smith2020}}.
A beta-blocker reduced the frequency of premature ventricular contractions by 40% in a randomised trial {{cite:lee2019}}.
A convolutional network has been proven to detect atrial fibrillation from single-lead ECG in all patients [3].
Beta-blockers also improve long-term survival after heart surgery {{cite:lee2019}}.
Probiotic supplementation slows disease progression in Parkinson's disease [4].
